// rootDir: NOT the tool directory. rootlist.ts imports src/utils/retry and the
archive-name round-trip test imports src/settings, so a rootDir of '.'

// module: Overridden from the root's 'commonjs'. move-archives-to-folder.ts guards
its entrypoint with `import.meta.main` — a Bun property, and the only
reliable direct-run check for a file Bun loads as ESM. `import.meta` is
a TS1343 error under 'commonjs'. Bun strips types and runs the file the
same way either way; this only changes what tsc will accept.
// exclude: MANDATORY OVERRIDE, not tidiness. `extends` inherits the root's exclude,
and relative paths in a base config resolve against the BASE file's
directory — so the root's 'scripts' entry resolves to <repo>/scripts and
would exclude this entire tool, leaving tsc with no input files at all.
Re-stating exclude here drops that entry.
